title: NIST WebBook: Lead is Pb, molecular weight 207.2 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Lead as Pb, molecular weight 207.2 amu, CAS 7439-92-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Lead, CAS Registry Number 7439-92-1, lists molecular formula Pb and molecular weight 207.2 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 207.9766521 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Pb. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
